text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Twin Turbo burns out completely and 
loses, her passionate running touches 
hearts and draws thunderous applause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She fires herself up to win next time. The 
sight of her running like a blazing 
fire... will surely keep thrilling 
everyone from now on.
